name: Route a Request
description: Decides once what a request asks of the system: to be told something (information), to have something done or changed (act), to have text written and handed back in the reply (draft), or that it cannot be acted on yet (clarify). The arms are one cheap classifier call, the route read off the plan the Planner made, and an always-information floor.
purpose: Understand what a request asks for before the system answers, acts or writes, in one place.
approach: Give the request, and what the Mind can already see, to an arm that returns one route from the closed list with a reason; an arm that cannot decide raises and the route is never guessed.
out_of_scope: Choosing the worker for each piece (the Planner does that), whether an action is allowed (Judgment Calls) and writing the reply (the Response Writer).
milestones: 1. The route matches a reader's label on the labelled request set (authoritative metric metric-route-a-request).
measures_of_success: The share of requests routed to the route a reader says they ask for.
inputs: A request and, optionally, the view of what the Mind can already see.
outputs: The route (information, act, draft or clarify) and a one sentence reason.
effects: Reads and writes nothing itself; the classifier arm makes one model call through Model Plumbing.
usage_notes: `hubofhubs.run("route-a-request", {"request": ...})` returns the route and reason. Until the live stage measures the classifier, the arm the metric selects is the floor, which answers information for everything: a consumer chooses its own arm for itself (the classifier, or `plan_derived` over its own planner's report).
